tool_schemas.name: API-get-user
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single user (person or bot) by user_id and returns the full user object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_id does not match the required format, UNAUTHORIZED if the integration token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the integration does not have access to the requested user, and NOT_FOUND if no user exists with that ID.

user_id.description: ID of the user (person or bot) to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: API-get-users

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

tool_schemas.name: API-get-self
tool_schemas.description: Returns the bot user associated with the current integration token. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the token is not authorized to act as an integration bot (for example, a token without a bot identity).

tool_schemas.name: API-post-database-query
tool_schemas.description: Queries a database and returns a paged list of matching pages (records) in that database; results honor filter and sorts and paginate with start_cursor/page_size, returning next_cursor and has_more. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid database_id, malformed filter/sorts, unknown sort property names, or page_size outside 1–100; UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks access to the database; and NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist.

database_id.description: ID of the database to query.

filter.description: Filter object used to constrain results by indexed database properties.

property.description: Database property name to sort by.

page_size.description: Maximum number of pages to return.

tool_schemas.name: API-post-search
tool_schemas.description: Searches across content the integration can access and returns a paged list of results (pages and/or databases), paginated with start_cursor/page_size and returning next_cursor and has_more; query, sort, and filter refine which objects are returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid sort or filter payload (including unsupported filter property/value combinations) or page_size outside 1–100, UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the integration is not permitted to search.

filter.description: Filter configuration for narrowing results by object type.

value.description: Object type to include in results.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tool_schemas.name: API-get-block-children
tool_schemas.description: Lists the child blocks for a parent block and returns them as a paged collection using start_cursor/page_size, returning next_cursor and has_more. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if block_id is invalid or page_size is outside 1–100, UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks access to the block, and NOT_FOUND if the parent block does not exist.

block_id.description: ID of the parent block whose children will be listed.

page_size.description: Maximum number of child blocks to return.

tool_schemas.name: API-patch-block-children
tool_schemas.description: Appends one or more child blocks to the end of the specified parent block and returns the updated children listing (including the newly appended blocks). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if block_id is invalid, children is empty, any child has an unsupported structure for its type, or required fields are missing; UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks permission to edit the parent block; NOT_FOUND if the parent block does not exist; and CONFLICT if the parent block cannot accept children in its current state or type.

block_id.description: ID of the parent block to append children to.

tool_schemas.name: API-retrieve-a-block
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single block by block_id and returns the block object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if block_id is not in the correct format, UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks access to the block, and NOT_FOUND if no block exists with that ID.

block_id.description: ID of the block to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: API-update-a-block
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing block (for example archived and/or type-specific content) and returns the updated block. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if block_id is invalid, the content payload is malformed or incompatible with the block’s type, or no updatable fields are provided; UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks permission to update the block; NOT_FOUND if the block does not exist; and CONFLICT if the requested change is not allowed for the block’s current state.

block_id.description: The ID of the block to update (blk_01H...).

tool_schemas.name: API-delete-a-block
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) a block by block_id and returns the archived block. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if block_id is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks permission to archive the block, NOT_FOUND if the block does not exist, and CONFLICT if the block cannot be archived due to its current state or constraints.

block_id.description: The ID of the block to delete/archive (blk_01H...).

tool_schemas.name: API-retrieve-a-page
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a page by page_id and returns the page object, including its properties and metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_id is not in the correct format, UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks access to the page, and NOT_FOUND if no page exists with that ID.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to retrieve (pg_01H...).

tool_schemas.name: API-patch-page
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing page by setting/replacing the provided page properties and/or updating its icon, cover, archived, or trashed flags, returning the updated page object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_id is malformed, if properties/icon/cover payloads are invalid, or if mutually incompatible fields are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot access the page, and CONFLICT if the update is refused due to the page’s current state (for example, attempting an invalid archived/trashed transition).

page_id.description: The ID of the page to update (pg_01H...).

properties.description: Page properties to set/replace (database property values).

tool_schemas.name: API-post-page
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new page under the specified parent (database, page, or workspace) with the given initial properties, and optionally creates the provided child blocks, returning the created page object (and its initial children as part of the page’s content). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parent.type is missing/invalid, if the corresponding parent identifier is missing or malformed, or if the properties/children payloads do not conform to the target database schema. Raises NOT_FOUND if the parent container does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks permission to create under the parent, and CONFLICT if the parent cannot accept a new child page in its current state.

parent.description: Parent container for the new page (database, page, or workspace).

type.description: The parent type for the new page.

children.description: Optional initial child blocks to create under the page.

items.description: A block object to create as a child.

tool_schemas.name: API-create-a-database
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new database under a page or workspace with the supplied title, optional description, and property schema, returning the created database object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parent.type is invalid, required parent identifiers are missing/malformed, or the properties_schema/title payload is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the parent container does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot create databases in the parent, and CONFLICT if creation is refused because the parent is not in a state that allows database creation.

parent.description: Parent container for the new database (page or workspace).

type.description: The parent type for the new database.

title.description: Database title as an array of rich text objects.

description.description: Database description as an array of rich text objects.

tool_schemas.name: API-update-a-database
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing database’s title, description, property schema, and/or status, returning the updated database object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is malformed, if the properties_schema update is invalid, or if status is not one of the allowed values; raises NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot modify the database, and CONFLICT if the requested change is refused due to database state (for example, disallowed status transitions or schema changes that cannot be applied).

database_id.description: The ID of the database to update (db_01H...).

title.description: Updated database title as an array of rich text objects.

description.description: Updated database description as an array of rich text objects.

properties_schema.description: Updates to the database property schema definition.

tool_schemas.name: API-retrieve-a-database
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single database by ID and returns the full database object including its title, description, and property schema. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if no database exists for the given ID. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the integration does not have access to the database.

database_id.description: The ID of the database to retrieve (db_01H...).

tool_schemas.name: API-retrieve-a-page-property
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single property item from a page by property identifier and returns the property value object for that item. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_id is malformed or property_id is missing/invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or the property_id is not present on the page. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot access the page.

page_id.description: ID of the page (pg_01H...) that contains the property.

property_id.description: Identifier of the property to retrieve (property key/id within the page's properties object).

tool_schemas.name: API-retrieve-a-comment
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single comment by ID and returns the comment object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if comment_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if the comment does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the integration does not have access to the comment’s page/discussion context.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment (cmt_01H...) to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: API-create-a-comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a comment on the specified page, either starting a new discussion or posting into an existing thread (via discussion_id) and optionally replying to a parent comment and/or anchoring to a block, returning the created comment object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_id or optional IDs are malformed, if rich_text is missing/invalid, or if the combination of discussion_id/parent_comment_id/anchor_block_id is inconsistent; raises NOT_FOUND if the page, anchor block, discussion, or parent comment does not exist in the page context. Raises FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot comment on the page, and CONFLICT if posting is refused due to the target thread/comment state (for example, replying where replies are not allowed).

page_id.description: ID of the page (pg_01H...) the comment is created on.

discussion_id.description: Existing discussion/thread identifier to post into (omit to start a new discussion).

parent_comment_id.description: ID of the parent comment (cmt_01H...) to reply to (optional).

anchor_block_id.description: ID of the block (blk_01H...) to anchor the comment to (optional).

rich_text.description: Rich text array content of the comment.

metadata.name: Notion
metadata.description: This backend stores a Notion-like workspace graph: users/bots, databases (schemas), pages (records), blocks (content tree), and comments.
